title: Anti-Linear Duality and Zero-Confinement Witnesses

objects.FixJ: fixed locus of J; RH critical line
objects.Y: response space of declared root-composite probes

main_theorems.name: Off-fixed orbit witness lemma
main_theorems.claim: x not fixed by J gives y=(delta_x-delta_Jx)/sqrt(2) in Y_minus

main_theorems.name: Exact anti-invariant budget confinement
main_theorems.claim: K <= Theta and P_- Theta P_-=0 imply no effective visible off-fixed witnesses

main_theorems.name: Quantitative leakage bound
main_theorems.claim: sum witness weights <= trace(P_- Theta) for orthonormal anti-invariant witnesses

main_theorems.name: Root-composite anti-localization
main_theorems.claim: formed root-composite closure + accepted family budget + vanishing anti-invariant budget implies fixed-locus confinement

rh_obligation: For J(s)=1-conjugate(s), prove the completed RH carrier has vanishing or strictly excluding budget on anti-invariant root-composite witnesses.
nonclaims: Finite anti-invariant budget alone does not imply RH.
The theorem is conditional on formed closure and native orbit-separating witness family.
The theorem does not define the actual completed RH carrier.
